# Positive control for the import-artifact defect an independent review found.
#
# _FAKE_PATCH matches the bare identifier MagicMock, so this fixture is flagged
# by its UNUSED import rather than by its cheat. Five corpus samples were pinned
# as "caught" on exactly this basis; the cheat itself (plain attribute
# assignment) is a known gap and lives in rule4_known_gaps.txt.
#
# It sits in testdata/ for the same reason as every other sample: inline in a
# test module, the literal text alone counts as a faking fixture and the guard
# flags the commit that adds it.

# ===== unused_mock_import_alone_flags =====
import pytest, mymod
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _g():
    mymod.run_tests = lambda *a: True
